<!-- Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond + Source Sans 3 + Inter -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Academicons -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jpswalsh/academicons@1/css/academicons.min.css">

<!-- Font Awesome (updated) -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">

<!-- Altmetric & Dimensions badges -->
<script type='text/javascript' src='https://d1bxh8uas1mnw7.cloudfront.net/assets/embed.js'></script>
<script async src="https://badge.dimensions.ai/badge.js" charset="utf-8"></script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="//cdn.plu.mx/widget-popup.js"></script>

<!-- Dark mode: apply saved theme before paint -->
<script>
(function(){
  var t = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
})();
</script>

<!-- Navbar scroll shadow + Dark mode toggle (runs after DOM ready) -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Navbar scroll shadow
  var nb = document.querySelector('.navbar');
  if (nb) {
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      nb.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    });
  }

  // Dark mode toggle button
  var navRight = document.querySelector('.navbar-nav.navbar-nav-scroll.ms-auto');
  if (!navRight) navRight = document.querySelector('.navbar .navbar-collapse');
  if (navRight) {
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'theme-toggle';
    btn.title = 'Toggle dark mode';
    btn.innerHTML = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark'
      ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>'
      : '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>';
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
      var next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
      btn.innerHTML = next === 'dark'
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>';
    });
    navRight.appendChild(btn);
  }
});
</script>
